challenge: Nothing logged over the weekend, so you're well rested. Today's the calmest afternoon in a while in New Buffalo: dry, about 40°F now warming to around 61°F from 1 to 5 PM, with light wind (5 to 7 mph). That makes it a good kayak day. Paddle easy in the early afternoon, then do Total Gym legs and pushups at a moderate effort. Labs are Wednesday morning, so keep it moderate and skip anything to failure. WHOOP hadn't scored today's recovery yet this morning, so go by feel.
items: Kayak 30–40 min, easy steady paddle (early afternoon, ~60°F, light wind)
Total Gym legs: 3 x 15 squats, 2 x 12 single-leg squats each side, 2 x 15 calf raises (moderate incline)
